article.story: Eastern Michigan (3-3) at Akron (1-4), Oct. 10 at 3:30 p.m. EDT. Opening Line: Eastern Michigan by 5.5. Against the spread: Eastern Michigan 3-3, Akron 2-3. How to watch: ESPN+ Key stats Eastern Michigan Offense Overall: 311.8 yards per game (124th in FBS) Passing: 200.2 yards per game (97th) Rushing: 111.7 yards per game (123rd) Scoring: 22.2 points per game (107th) Eastern Michigan Defense Overall: 363.7 yards per game (81st in FBS) Passing: 229.8 yards per game (96th) Rushing: 133.8 yards per game (63rd) Scoring: 25 points per game (80th) Akron Offense Overall: 338 yards per game (113th in FBS) Passing: 197 yards per game (100th) Rushing: 141 yards per game (93rd) Scoring: 19 points per game (120th) Akron Defense Overall: 424.4 yards per game (127th in FBS) Passing: 235.8 yards per game (108th) Rushing: 188.6 yards per game (122nd) Scoring: 33.6 points per game (128th) Akron is 130th in the FBS with a -6 turnover margin, compared to Eastern Michigan's 47th-ranked +2 margin. Eastern Michigan is 15th in the FBS averaging 39.8 penalty yards per game. Team leaders Eastern Michigan Passing: Noah Kim, 1,187 yards, 8 TDs, 3 INTs, 62.6 completion percentage Rushing: Amareon Blue, 309 yards on 60 carries, 3 TDs Receiving: Harold Mack, 264 yards on 23 catches, 2 TDs Akron Passing: Brayden Roggow, 605 yards, 3 TDs, 4 INTs, 55.8 completion percentage Rushing: Jordan Gant, 289 yards on 61 carries, 3 TDs Receiving: Marcel Williams, 201 yards on 20 catches, 0 TDs Last game Eastern Michigan won 38-14 over UMass on Oct. 3. Kim threw for 219 yards on 21-of-30 attempts (70.0%) with two touchdowns and no interceptions. Blue carried the ball 11 times for 66 yards and scored one touchdown. Mack put up 49 yards on three catches. Akron lost 41-17 to Central Michigan on Oct. 3. Roggow led Akron with 180 yards on 15-of-32 passing (46.9%) for one touchdown and two interceptions. Gant carried the ball 17 times for 102 yards and scored one touchdown, adding one reception for 27 yards. Williams had two receptions for 36 yards. Next game Eastern Michigan hosts Toledo on Oct. 17. Akron plays at Miami (OH) on Oct. 17.
